objective: Restore point-in-time announcement evidence from the existing Eastmoney source using bounded, verifiable date-window pagination, while retaining explicit DATA_BLOCKED behavior for unverified coverage.
non_goals: No new data provider or paid entitlement.
No change to U4 selection, paper registration, trading or Macro authority.
No rewrite of existing immutable runs or production records.
input_contracts: Eastmoney announcement response with success, page identity, total_hits, dates and titles
Existing Tushare anns_d fallback, which may return permission denied
output_artifacts: Bounded announcement evidence and explicit coverage status
Negative behavior tests and mutation evidence
Draft PR with isolated live-source acceptance results
acceptance_tests: Reject inconsistent page totals, duplicate or missing pages, invalid dates, future rows and coverage beyond the bounded limit.
A real read-only source probe for at least one stock succeeds without printing or persisting credentials.
approval_gates: No production synchronization or merge without Junyan approval.
No U4 selection or paper action is implied by battery completeness.
